State that charge labels, including d, are fixed simple-object representatives, or specify unitary isomorphisms for these cases. Penneys uses a representative set Irr(C) in Definition 3.5.1: [source](https://people.math.osu.edu/penneys.2/UQSL/ArchivedNotes/TPM/FusionCats.pdf).

In proof step 1.2, [F2] permits choosing an orthogonal semisimple decomposition; it does not make an arbitrary decomposition orthogonal. Explicitly choose an orthogonal decomposition before using its inclusions and projections.

The stated multiplicity space is V_ab^c=Hom(a⊗b,c), but its proposed basis vector is called the inclusion c→a⊗b, which has the reverse type. Use the adjoint projection a⊗b→c for the multiplicity-space basis; retain the inclusion for the coevaluation construction.
